crossRefs.note: When it was evening he came with the twelve.
When the hour had come, he sat down with the twelve apostles.
When Jesus had said this, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Most certainly I tell you that one of you will…
This is how you shall eat it: with your belt on your waist, your sandals on your feet, and your staff in your hand; and…
While the king sat at his table, my perfume spread its fragrance.

parallels.note: When it was evening he came with the twelve.

translations.web: Now when evening had come, he was reclining at the table with the twelve disciples.
